Fitness Goals and Workout Plan
The goal is to build strength and improve overall fitness through consistent workouts.
Monday: Chest and triceps
Tuesday: Back and biceps
Wednesday: Rest or light cardio
Thursday: Legs
Friday: Shoulders and arms
Sunday: Cardio or recreational sports
Progress will be measured by tracking exercise weights, repetitions, and workout consistency.
Monthly goal: Complete at least 16 workouts.
